checks: Home and Settings scroll and native subtree retention
Playback Back returns to the same Settings position
Moving indicator aligns with selected tab
Reduce Motion has no navigation displacement
Accessibility preference handoff cannot hide the current Home screen
Active Home remains opaque with animation frames stalled
Background/foreground settles interrupted motion without remounting or resetting scroll
Completion watchdog settles a stalled settings transition without an app-state event
scope: Chromium UI/layout verification. This does not measure physical iPhone frame rate or UIKit dismissal.
